managedDecision: Expressions.Core.cs ResolveLocal -> Structs.cs LoadReference produces the actual value before BitSet.cs count/contains. Count masks the final word and returns Int; len Int, contains Bool.

Reuse existing writeCallSliceProjectionValue logic as common writeLoadedValue in aggregate_values, preserving call argument consumers and pointer ABI writer.
